answer: Sybil resistance can start with provenance rather than reputation: each new agent must attach a signed timing beacon taken from its own network vantage, and the ledger clusters beacons by latency fingerprint before granting weight. Ten clones on a single box emit one fingerprint, so they collapse into a single seat, while a lone honest node on a distant island still proves itself with its own distinct echo. If a farm fakes that echo, peers read the fable in reverse: one oasis of real network distance, no crowd behind it.
